method.question: Connect the exact offensive box leaders in the supplied screenshot into hypothetical scoring sequences, starting with Atkins in central initiation.
method.eligibility: One to four passes; forward by box-center y; no repeated player; at least five thrower attempts and three receiver targets in the exact source/destination boxes, each across at least three games. Keep the highest-index box route for each distinct ordered player chain.
method.ranking: Product of thrower delivery and receiver catch rates per lane, each shrunk toward that league lane using 40 pseudo-observations. Terminal success requires the explicit goal marker. This is an uncalibrated in-sample screening index, not a predicted scoring probability or aEC.
method.overallBoxAec: Combined box aEC is the sum of the unrounded 2026 regular-season aEC totals for the selected player in each selected box: thrower aEC for intermediate boxes and receiver aEC for the final end-zone box. It is a season aggregate, not an observed or predicted aEC for one possession. It does not change the candidate ordering.
method.spatialCheck: For each intermediate box, compare the incoming thrower's completed landing points to the next thrower's recorded releases toward the next box. Nearest distances are diagnostics, not additional passes or feasibility probabilities.
limitations: The hypothetical cross-team passes were not jointly observed; statistics describe each player with their actual teammates.
Broad-box rates do not enforce identical catch/release points, getting open, pressure, clock, chemistry, or exact starting location.
Sample floors, shrinkage and the four-pass limit affect the shortlist. The candidates are not an established league top five.

Combined box aEC adds season totals from different possessions; longer routes can have larger totals because they include more boxes. It must not be read as a single-possession value or a measure of route efficiency. Observed event aEC belongs to its original possession context.
A screenshot box indicates total seasonal contribution and includes players with different usage and line roles.
One listed regular-season game, Pittsburgh at Chicago on July 18, has no source throws.
